purpose: Evaluate whether chip projection over a manual gold graph makes the GM better prepared for the next session while preserving source boundaries.

dimensions.name: focus_session_clarity
dimensions.two: Clearly distinguishes focus Session 24 vs prior/global context

questions.question: What is the exact situation as Session 25 opens?
must_include: Immediate battle ended
Full night has fallen
Ephanna/Stafl/Baergrom are at the wall above the gate for watch and short rest
Others are checking town and planning for Edge refugees
Meat piles turned to goo and sank underground
Grobnok callback and Lysandra rockie-talkie link are pending

questions.question: Who went where after the fight?
must_include: Ephanna, Stafl, and Baergrom stay at the wall above the gate for watch and short rest
The others go check town and create a refugee plan

questions.question: What do I need to remember about the Edge refugees before I roleplay the next scene?
must_include: The refugees from Edge still need a plan
Screening, housing, admission, safety, and taint status are unresolved
Edge remains connected to the crisis

questions.question: Is the north wall damaged, and what caused it?
must_include: A hybrid reached the wall and chipped away the foundation
The golem dashed to the wall ready to break it down
A sewer monster climbed onto the wall
Structural integrity remains unresolved

questions.question: What happened when they tried to burn the remains?
must_include: Karsemine and Ephanna try to burn remaining meat piles
Firebolt/Bonfire cause piles to turn to goo and get sucked underground
This remains an unresolved threat or hook

questions.question: What monster mechanics have been revealed that I should carry forward?
must_include: Tripods have ignitable gases/flesh and can impale/pull with launched spikes
Meatwings compel targets toward consuming monsters and can prevent direct attacks
Hybrids can attack and damage the wall/foundation
Golem is immune to poison/charm and weak to fire
Sewer monsters climb walls, ooze sticky gel, and can spray poison on death

questions.question: Which enemies were shown to be weak to fire?
must_include: Karsemine's Firebolt ignites tripod gases/flesh and kills one tripod
Hunter's Mark reveals the golem is weak to fire

questions.question: How exactly did the meatwing compulsion work?
must_include: Targets are compelled to find and eat the monsters
Targets cannot attack the monsters directly
Ephanna and Bonogo were affected early; later Thrin, Karsemine, Ephanna, Bonogo, Caelynn, and Baergrom were enchanted

questions.question: What happened to Ephanna in the fight that might matter next?
must_include: Ephanna is compelled by meatwings
Ephanna climbs down and destroys a hybrid with Eldritch Blast
A tripod impales and pulls Ephanna
A hybrid hits Ephanna with necrotic damage
Karsemine accidentally shoots Ephanna
Ephanna stays at the wall for short rest/watch

questions.question: What was Baergrom's big tactical moment?
must_include: Baergrom uses Bait and Switch to move Thrin out of harm's way
Baergrom uses Commander’s Strike to direct Bonogo
Bonogo kills the sewer monster attacking Ogonob

questions.question: What did Caelynn tell Grobnok, and what is pending?
must_include: Caelynn tells Grobnok about Edge and Mireward Reach
Grobnok is frustrated
Caelynn attempts to connect Grobnok's rockie-talkie with Lysandra's
The connection will take time
Grobnok will call back next day

questions.question: What should Lysandra's state and priorities be after the fight?
must_include: Lysandra has been commanding attacks and removing Caelynn's charm
She recognizes advantage and pushes final assault
She is relevant to town/refugee/security decisions and pending Grobnok communication

questions.question: Is the battle over?
must_include: The immediate battlefield fight ends when Thrin finishes the final tripod
The broader crisis is not over because meat goo sinks underground, refugees need a plan, and Edge remains unresolved

questions.question: List the unresolved hooks I should prep for the next session.
must_include: Refugee handling
Wall/foundation inspection or consequences
Meat goo underground
Current status of Edge
Grobnok callback
Pending Grobnok-Lysandra link
Short-rest/watch pressure

questions.question: When I click Caelynn, what should the projection show?
must_include: Charmed then cleansed by Lysandra
Magic Missile against meatwings and final tripod attack
Caelynn called Grobnok about Edge and Mireward Reach
Adjacency to Lysandra, Grobnok, rockie-talkie bridge, Edge, Mireward Reach, meatwings, and final tripod event

questions.question: When I click Tripod meat monsters, what should I see?
must_include: Session 24 focus evidence for fire/gas damage, meatwing waking a sleeping tripod, impaling/pulling Ephanna, Sleep/Luck control, and final coordinated kill
Adjacency to Karsemine, Stafl, Ephanna, Thrin, meatwings, and final assault

questions.question: When I click Edge refugees, what should I see?
must_include: Session 24 evidence that something needs to be done with refugees from Edge
Unresolved status for screening, housing, admission, and taint
Adjacency to Edge and town/refugee planning team

questions.question: When I click meat goo sinking underground, what should I see?
must_include: Attempted burning caused meat piles to turn to goo and get sucked underground
This is unresolved
Adjacency to battlefield, Karsemine, Ephanna, and future investigation

questions.question: When I click the north wall, what should I see?
must_include: Hybrid foundation damage
Golem wall-breaking pressure
Sewer monster climbed onto wall and sticky gel made movement difficult
Watch/rest team remains above the gate
Structural integrity unresolved

questions.question: Which graph items should be high-risk or frictioned before approval?
must_include: Wall safety/structural integrity
Refugee screening/admission/housing
Meat goo destination and consequence
Exact Edge status
Grobnok-Lysandra link completion
Exact resources/HP/slot state

questions.question: What proposed writes would this preview generate?
must_include: Pending battle resolution write
Pending monster mechanics updates
Pending unresolved hooks for meat goo, wall damage, refugees, Edge status, Grobnok callback, and rockie-talkie bridge
All proposed writes remain pending manual review

questions.question: Which Session 23 facts should the projection pull in to make Session 24 make sense?
must_include: Only focused prior context needed for continuity: Edge refugees/refugee origin, north gate setup, enemy wave identities, and Lysandra/Mireward context
Avoid broad Session 23 recap flooding

questions.question: What happened with Baergrom's crossbow?
must_include: Baergrom readies his crossbow, it jams, he throws it down, grabs a short bow, loads an arrow, and shoots the hybrid in the head

questions.question: How many meatwings were left at the end?
must_include: The source does not preserve a reliable exact final meatwing count
The immediate battle ends, but exact remaining meatwing count should not be fabricated

questions.question: Are the refugees definitely tainted by the meat horror?
must_include: The recap does not resolve the refugees' taint or screening status
Treat it as a pending triage risk, not a fact

questions.question: Can Grobnok now talk directly to Lysandra?
must_include: Caelynn attempts to connect Grobnok's rockie-talkie with Lysandra’s
The recap says this will take some time
The direct link is not complete in the source

questions.question: Did burning the meat piles solve the goo problem?
must_include: No. The attempted burning caused the piles to turn to goo and sink underground
This creates or preserves an unresolved risk rather than solving it
